messages:
evan: Morning — quick sync on Snow/DBX + vector sandbox handoff to infra for connector tests.
priya: TL;DR: need staging creds + network allowlist + one sample pipeline that runs end->end so partners can validate connector behavior and perf.
lina: I uploaded a 1k-row sample to s3: s3://redwood-samples/retail_1k.csv. Schema: customer_id, ts, product_text, price. Use this for vectorization tests.
lina: Snowflake quick load example:
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE raw.retail (customer_id STRING, ts TIMESTAMP, product_text STRING, price FLOAT);
COPY INTO raw.retail FROM 's3://redwood-samples/retail_1k.csv' FILE_FORMAT=(TYPE=CSV FIELD_DELIMITER=',');
```
priya: For Databricks, use the workspace token I shared in the partner_doc vault. Minimal spark job snippet:
```py
df = spark.read.csv('s3://redwood-samples/retail_1k.csv', header=True)
df.write.format('delta').save('/mnt/redwood/retail_delta')
```
ev an: Qdrant/weaviate endpoints: partners will stand up a single-node qdrant in the staging VPC. We just need a reachable HTTPS endpoint and API key.
sam: I can provision the staging VPC and add a NAT + static egress IP. Questions:
- do you want per-partner IPs or one shared? (shared is faster for onboarding)
- do we need mutual TLS to partner endpoints?
priya: Shared egress IP is fine for the initial sandbox. mTLS no for now, but keep the option in doc. We'll pass an API key.
sam: OK I'll open a CIDR for Snowflake and Databricks control plane IPs and create a short-lived sandbox role for inbound connector tests. ETA: Tue EOD (48h).
lina: Also need a sample API contract for the connector healthcheck endpoint so partners can run acceptance tests. Example response:
{
  "status": "ok",
  "version": "v1.0.0",
  "ingest_latency_ms": 120
}
priya: Ops: please add terraform snippets to the repo under infra/partner-sandboxes so partners can reproduce. Owner: @sam. PR checklist:
- terraform for vpc, nat, egress ip
- secrets in vault + short TTL
- smoke pipeline: s3 -> snow -> vector -> query
sam: noted. I'll open the PR and tag @lina for the smoke pipeline tests.
deploy-bot: sandbox-provision-job scheduled by sam for 2024-06-08T16:00Z — job id sbx-3421 :construction:
evan: timeline for partner demo? We aligned on next Friday for internal review, public joint demo two weeks after that.
priya: Action items:
- sam: infra PR + allowlist (due Tue EOD)
- lina: commit smoke pipeline scripts & sample queries (due Wed)
- evan: draft joint announcement checklist and private marketplace listing steps (due Thu)
- all: quick sync Thu AM to confirm readiness
lina: I'll add sample vector queries and expected QA checks (recall @0.9, latency <200ms).
priya: Thanks — keeping this tight will help the partner launch timeline. :thumbsup:
ev an: ping if anything blocks, otherwise I'll loop in partner success to schedule hands-on lab once infra is green.
